subject: Re: Pricing & model mix — token volumes and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Ava Thompson <ava@brightlayer.io>
Cc: Jordan Keller <jordan.k@brightlayer.io>
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap — model mix & token volumes

Hi Ava / Jordan,

Thanks again for the time on today's call — really helpful to understand BrightLayer's ingestion / search workflow. Quick recap and the asks I took away so we can align on pricing: 

Summary of model mix we discussed:
- Chat (user-facing assistants & summarization): ~55% of token volume
- Embeddings (semantic search + similarity): ~35% of token volume
- Reranking (ML-based ranking step on top of search): ~10% of token volume

Estimated monthly token volumes (example bucket):
- Peak month estimate: 1.2M API calls / ~600M total tokens
- Typical month: ~800k calls / ~400M tokens

Budget / unit economics guidance we discussed: 
- Target unit economics: BrightLayer is aiming for ~$750–$1,200 per 1M tokens across the stack (blended).
- Key drivers: model choices, sequence length assumptions, and prefix caching of repeated contexts.

Immediate next steps I promised: 
1) Send a short pricing sketch (per-model unit $/1M tokens + blended example) with a couple of scenarios (standard vs optimized quantized runtime).
2) Share a token-volume template for you to confirm per-model splits and sequence lengths.
3) Propose two commercial options: standard hosted consumption and a reserved/dedicated commit if you want predictable unit costs.

If the model mix / volume estimates above look right, I’ll send the pricing sheet + proposal later today. If not, please reply with any adjustments (esp. average sequence lengths for chat and rerank).

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0118

From: Ava Thompson <ava@brightlayer.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2027 12:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap — model mix & token volumes

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the clear recap — this matches our internal read. A few clarifications: 
- Embeddings are used for both indexing and runtime similarity; average vector size will be 1536 tokens equivalent per request (we currently batch embeddings, so per-call effective tokens are lower).
- Chat: average sequence length ~850 tokens (prompt + response) for our long-form summaries; some lighter assistant flows are ~200 tokens.
- Rerank: short contexts, ~120 tokens per call but high QPS during spikes.

Budget wise, we are comfortable targeting the $1,000 per 1M tokens blended number if there’s a clear path to predictable costs at scale.

Yes please send the pricing sketch and the token-volume template — Jordan will populate the sheet and get it back to you by Monday.

Best,
Ava
Ava Thompson
Head of Product, BrightLayer
ava@brightlayer.io
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Apr 2027 10:23:00 -0700
Subject: FW: Pricing sketch ask — quick pricing guidance?

Rishi / Steph — forwarding BrightLayer's clarifications from Ava. They confirmed: ~400M tokens typical (mix as above), target ~$1,000 per 1M blended. Key model details: chat avg 850 tokens, embeddings (1536 vector equiv per request but batched), rerank 120 tokens.

Can you confirm:
- Suggested per-model unit prices to hit ~$1,000/1M blended under both hosted and optimized-quantized (dedicated) profiles?
- Any immediate recommendations (e.g., run embeddings on quantized 8-bit to save cost, rerank on CPU vs GPU given short contexts)?

I’ll include your guidance in the customer proposal. Need this today if possible — they want an internal review early next week.

Thanks — Marissa
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Ava Thompson <ava@brightlayer.io>
Cc: Jordan Keller <jordan.k@brightlayer.io>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing proposal & token-volume template (attached)

Hi Ava / Jordan,

Attached is a short pricing proposal and the token-volume workbook you can fill out. Highlights below (blended examples use your \"typical month\" ~400M tokens):

Scenario A — Hosted (no commit):
- Chat (gpt-chat-xx): $1,200 per 1M tokens
- Embeddings (embed-1536): $250 per 1M tokens (after batching efficiency)
- Rerank (rerank-s): $600 per 1M tokens
- Blended example: ~ $1,030 per 1M tokens (based on 55/35/10 split and the sequence lengths you provided)

Scenario B — Dedicated / Optimized (3-6 month reserved commit):
- Chat (quantized runtime): $780 per 1M tokens
- Embeddings (quantized + batching): $180 per 1M tokens
- Rerank (optimized kernels): $420 per 1M tokens
- Blended example: ~ $820 per 1M tokens

Notes and assumptions:
- Embedding price reflects amortized cost when batched and run on x86-optimized instances.
- Rerank savings assume we can use a low-latency quantized path or CPU-based batched scoring depending on QPS pattern.
- For chat we assumed average response length 850 tokens; if average drops to 400 tokens, hosted estimate falls ~20–25%.

Attachments: BL-pricing-proposal-v2.pdf, brightlayer-token-volumes.xlsx
DocuSign (proposal) link: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abcd-1234
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/BL-2027-004

Next steps:
- Jordan: populate the token-volume sheet and return by EOD Monday so we can lock a recommended plan.
- I’ll follow up on a draft SOW / reserved-commit pricing if you choose Scenario B.

Looking forward — happy to jump back on a call to walk through the numbers.

Best,
Marissa
